source.name: U.S. DOT Airline Family Seating Dashboard
source.method: Table read from the live page in a browser: row "Guarantees adjacent seats for a child 13 or under and an accompanying adult at no additional cost for all fare types", columns Alaska, Allegiant, American, Delta, Frontier, Hawaiian, JetBlue, Southwest, United.

fareTypesSource: Dashboard row: "Guarantees adjacent seats for a child 13 or under and an accompanying adult at no additional cost for all fare types". The dashboard names no fare type that is excluded.

conditions.text: Child and accompanying adult are on the same reservation
Adjacent seats are available at the time of booking in the selected class of service
Aircraft is not substituted for smaller aircraft
Adult either chooses seats for the entire reservation or skips seats for the entire reservation, and does not make changes to seat assignments once assigned to them
It is physically possible based on seat layout to seat the number of young children traveling next to the accompanying adult(s)

assignedBy: If the conditions are satisfied, airlines that assign seats and guarantee fee-free family seating provide adjacent seat assignments to the adult traveling with a child age 13 or under no later than the day before the flight.
